motivation.v2Outcome: The V2 token path passes rotation gates but fails the edge-replacement generic-runtime ceiling at 1.143x.
motivation.v2Diagnostic: Five Deno MemoryVDOMHost processes show a +1.796 ms median token-minus-generic owner.expand-and-cache difference on edge replacement; source inspection suggests full keyed output-directory construction may contribute.
motivation.pilot: One unfrozen sequential pilot showed token-delta could delete/upsert cache entries after commit and retain a fast path for the following rotation. It is excluded from the preregistered replication set and preserved separately.

question: Can staged delta maintenance of the keyed output directory reduce owner expansion/cache work on edge replacement while preserving the token reuse fast path for the next same-key rotation and preserving keyed state/host identity?

hypotheses.H1: For edge replacement, token-delta lowers owner.expand-and-cache median by at least 25% of the token arm's excess over generic, summarized as the median across five process-level paired improvement shares.
hypotheses.H2: For the immediately following same-key rotation, token-delta root.flush median is no more than 1.10x the token arm's median across the five process replications.
hypotheses.H3: Each token-delta edge update stages one removed owner, one removed output, one new owner mapping, and one output upsert; the next rotation has one token hit per row and no fallback.

design.rowState: A selected keyed sentinel at row-5000 is seeded before the workload and must remain selected.
sequencePerPair: replace the final key and change the region token
rotate the same membership and preserve the region token
design.pairOrder: A cyclic rotation of the three arm orders balances each arm's position four times across 12 measured pairs.
design.instrumentation: Runtime profile callbacks and work counters are enabled for all arms; all timings are diagnostic only.

correctnessGates: Output order and membership parity after edge replacement and rotation.
Retained host identity for every surviving key and a new host for the inserted key.
The seeded row-5000 local state remains selected after every operation.
Token-delta cache update is applied only after successful host commit; the following rotation reuses the refreshed directory.

analysisPlan.replicationUnit: Fresh Deno process; samples inside a process are nested.
analysisPlan.summary: Median of each process's 12 update samples, then median and range across five process medians; report process-level paired differences and improvement shares.
analysisPlan.decision: A mechanism pass can justify a later production-browser follow-up, but cannot repair or replace the V2 browser fallback gate by itself.
limitations: Memory-host phase timings do not include browser DOM, layout, paint, presentation, or React.
Diagnostic callbacks add overhead and phase scopes are not guaranteed to be additive.
Only one-row edge replacement followed by one same-membership rotation is tested; filters and multi-key changes are outside this diagnostic.

sourceBase: The experimental runtime is copied from the V2 source-lock snapshot; the original V2 runtime and source lock are not modified.
